answer.rationale: Primary-region-only write-path degradation with p99 at 5× target points to a localized regional issue rather than a platform-wide fault. The release cannot be rolled back due to compliance. Circuit breakers address partner outages, not regional degradation. Read-replica routing helps dashboard load but not write latency. Adding capacity does not address the root cause if the region itself is degraded. Regional failover has prior evidence of clean recovery within minutes (memory_b2) and directly targets the confined regional degradation while preserving the active release and its security patch. Settlement peak writes are heavy, so failover must ensure no write loss; memory_b2 confirms traffic shifted cleanly with error-rate recovery in minutes.
